name: Teferi, Time Raveler
oracle_text:
Each opponent can cast spells only any time they could cast a sorcery.
+1: Until your next turn, you may cast sorcery spells as though they had flash.
−3: Return up to one target artifact, creature, or enchantment to its owner's hand. Draw a card.
blocked_sentences: +1: Until your next turn, you may cast sorcery spells as though they had flash.

needs.what: a one-shot effect op (from a loyalty ability) that writes a per-player timing permission read by casting._timing_ok -- 'you may cast sorcery spells as though they had flash' -- lasting until the granting player's next turn (cleared in their untap step, dropped if they leave), covering cards drawn after it resolved, with a spell filter narrowing it to Sorcery spells
needs.why_existing_wont_do: cast_as_though_flash exists only as a static (no op form, no duration) and refuses any spell filter, so it can be neither time-limited nor narrowed to sorceries; grant_keyword flash is not read by _timing_ok (it reads printed keywords) and cannot reach cards not yet in hand; the until_your_next_turn duration exists only on pump/lock_abilities/animate/grant_keyword/cant_block/prevent_damage_permanent/lock_life_total/grant_protection/delayed_trigger; an emblem with the static would be permanent
